# routeros_interface_ppp_server (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_interface_ppp_server" "server" {
  name         = "example"
  comment      = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  data_channel = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Descriptive name of the interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `authentication` (Set of String) Authentication methods that the server will accept.
- `comment` (String)
- `data_channel` (String) The modem channel that carries the PPP data connection.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `max_mru` (Number) Maximum Receive Unit. Maximum packet size that the interface will be able to receive without packet fragmentation.
- `max_mtu` (Number) Maximum Transmission Unit. Maximum packet size that the interface will be able to send without packet fragmentation.
- `modem_init` (String) Modem initialization string sent before the modem starts to answer calls.
- `mrru` (String) Maximum packet size that can be received on the link. If a packet is bigger than tunnel MTU, it will be split into multiple packets, allowing full size IP or Ethernet packets to be sent over the tunnel. Set to `disabled` to turn Multilink PPP off.
- `null_modem` (Boolean) Enables null-modem mode. When enabled, no modem initialization strings are sent and calls are not answered.
- `port` (String) The serial port the modem is connected to, as listed by the `/port` menu.
- `profile` (String) Specifies which PPP profile configuration will be used for the incoming connections.
- `ring_count` (Number) Number of rings to wait before answering the call.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `running` (Boolean)

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/interface/ppp-server get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_interface_ppp_server.server "*1"
```
